v1.14.0 development plan. PHASED, dataset-driven, theme E (Guardrails / data hygiene) selected 2026-05-05. All theme E issues shipped or in PR #109.

UPDATE 2026-05-05: Phase 1 soak ran 12 days (Apr 23 → May 5). Mid-soak dataset analysis (audit/telemetry from 2 machines) surfaced the bootstrap-overflow signal, anchoring theme E. See docs/investigation-bootstrap-overflow-2026-05-05.md + docs/dataset-2026-05-05-findings.md. Soak-exit policy codified same day — see project.soakPolicy.

PHASE 1 — SOAK (2026-04-23 → 2026-05-05, 12 days, exited early on data clarity)
Original signals to watch (still relevant for Phase 2 of any cycle):
- Empty-codex_get rate drops from 48% baseline (#92 acceptance)
- aliasResolved reliably captured on codex_run + codex_copy (#93/#94)
- context.next_session picks up organic use (#91 adoption)
- Seed-quality lint holds 0 false-positives (#82)
- Topology pair counts emerge past zero (#83)

PHASE 2 — THEME PICK (decided 2026-05-05, day 12)
Theme E added from soak findings (Guardrails / data hygiene), with #84 (entry health) pairing.

Original four themes (still valid framing for future cycles):
  A. Metadata maturity — #45, #84, #42
  B. Search / discoverability — #13, #43
  C. Distribution — #6, #49, #50, #51
  D. Polish / performance — #44, #47, #48

Dataset bias rules:
- Metadata conversations → A
- Agents struggling to locate entries → B (also see project.v115Hints — user pre-flagged for v1.15)
- New-user onboarding pain → C
- Response-time complaints → D
- Bootstrap overflow / silent data routing failures → E (the v1.14 signal)

PHASE 3 — DESIGN + BUILD (substantially complete)
- #99 SHIPPED via PR #104 (d9126b4). Design: docs/design-99-project-resolution-refusal.md.
- #102 SHIPPED via PRs #106/#107 (001ac9e). Bug fix, no design doc.
- #100 + #101 SHIPPED via PR #108 (d18923f). Designs: docs/design-100-context-size-budget.md + docs/design-101-write-amp-guard.md.
- #103 IN PR #109. Last open issue.

#84 deferred to v1.15.

PHASE 4 — CI / INDIE ITEMS
#96 shipped via PR #98 on 2026-04-28 — Phase 4 empty.

RELEASE
After #109 merges: bump package.json, transform [Unreleased] → [1.14.0] in CHANGELOG, run release alias. See docs/release-checklist.md.

DOGFOODING PART THREE
Expected alongside v1.14.0 tag. Theme E narrative: loop closed + soak policy codified + guardrails grew from FA-iOS dataset mine.

SOAK POLICY CALIBRATION
v1.14 is the N=1 calibration sample for project.soakPolicy. Single-machine 7d snapshot at exit: 16 sessions, 281 calls, 7 namespaces, 4 projects — clears the gate. Refine with v1.15.

ANTI-PATTERN WARNINGS (still applicable to v1.15)
- Don't pre-commit to a theme before Phase 1 data
- Don't let the candidate list sprawl past 5 shipped items
- Don't skip the design pass on a behavior-changing surface — silent-fallthrough refusal needed it (PR #104), size-budget needed it (PR #108)
- Don't re-audit the bootstrap-overflow area without a new finding (#99-103 fully cover it)
- Don't soak past 14 days even on thin signal
